The main text explicitly states '王敦昔肆酷汝父' (Wang Dun formerly cruelly treated your father), confirming that the person referred to as 王大將軍 in the story is Wang Dun. The Liu annotation evidence sfh1-ev-36-chouxi-003-liu-annotation-001 mentions '王敦' in the context of the same events (司馬丞 being killed), and sfh1-ev-36-chouxi-003-liu-annotation-002 continues the narrative about 敦 plotting rebellion. The office title 大將軍 is consistent with Wang Dun's historical role as 大將軍. The hard veto against c1 (explicit identity contradiction) is noted but does not affect this c0 resolution. The evidence directly supports the identification of 王大將軍 as 王敦.
